name: gemini-worker
description: Let Claude Code hand paper polishing, PDF and image reading, and second opinions to Google Gemini through the Antigravity CLI, on your own Google account (no API key). A script checks that numbers, citations and math survive polishing; Gemini stays read-only. 在 Claude Code 里调用 Gemini 润色论文、读 PDF 和图片、给第二意见。
